name: M.358 275 MAX (MAXIMUS, 275 gr)

ballisticCoefficients.note: G1 BC, printed ".350 EST". Marked EST: estimated; the page states no accuracy. The velocity it applies to is not stated.
G7 BC, printed ".175 EST". Marked EST: estimated; the page states no accuracy. The velocity it applies to is not stated.

sources.note: Page 5, MAXIMUS Bullets: Caliber .358, Grains 275, Minimum Required Twist 1-12", Part Number M.358 275 MAX, G1 BC .350 EST, G7 BC .175 EST, OAL 1.623", BULLET PROJECTION 1.032"

note: Bullet projection (from the SealTite band to the tip, page footnote) printed: 1.032". The same G1 .350 and G7 .175 are printed for M.277 90 FCG.
